about: Message Center posts with PowerShell for the FEATURE itself (find where it is used, use it, move off it) - not only for reading the post. Written by hand or by the morning routine (routines/poranny-B-publish.md STEP -1d), checked by tools/mc_howto_todo.py check: every block parses, every Graph cmdlet and parameter exists in the Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK, scopes are named, writes carry -WhatIf. A post without a note shows nothing; `scriptable: false` says why no script exists. Author: Piotr Wisniewski.

notes.title: MemberOf rule operator in dynamic groups, dynamic administrative units and auto-assignment policies
notes.dates: 03/11/2026 - the preview ends: configurations that use memberOf stop updating and keep their last membership (MC1448379, MC1488834, MC1529463; Learn). Tenants with Microsoft Entra ID Governance or higher: existing configurations keep working until 31/03/2027, then Microsoft migrates them to a new MemberOf capability (MC1488839, published 05/10/2026). On 03/11/2026 the Learn pages still give only 03/11/2026 and do not mention the extension.

blocks.t: Find dynamic groups that use memberOf
blocks.code:
# Read only. Lists every dynamic group whose rule uses memberOf (a memberOf rule cannot be combined with other conditions).
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'GroupMember.Read.All' -NoWelcome
$groups = Get-MgGroup -Filter "groupTypes/any(c:c eq 'DynamicMembership')" -All `
    -Property Id, DisplayName, MembershipRule, MembershipRuleProcessingState
$memberOf = $groups | Where-Object { $_.MembershipRule -match '(?i)memberof' }
$memberOf | Select-Object DisplayName, Id, MembershipRuleProcessingState, MembershipRule |
    Export-Csv -Path .\memberof-dynamic-groups.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
"{0} of {1} dynamic groups use memberOf" -f @($memberOf).Count, @($groups).Count

blocks.t: Find dynamic administrative units that use memberOf
blocks.code:
# Read only. The filter runs on your computer, so no advanced query is needed.
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'AdministrativeUnit.Read.All' -NoWelcome
Get-MgDirectoryAdministrativeUnit -All -Property Id, DisplayName, MembershipType, MembershipRule, MembershipRuleProcessingState |
    Where-Object { $_.MembershipType -eq 'Dynamic' -and $_.MembershipRule -match '(?i)memberof' } |
    Select-Object DisplayName, Id, MembershipRuleProcessingState, MembershipRule

blocks.t: Find auto-assignment policies (access packages) that use memberOf
Keep a record of who is in each group before the date
How the feature is used: a memberOf group (test tenant only)
blocks.warn: The operator is a retiring preview: do not build new production groups on it. -WhatIf shows what would be created; remove it only in a test tenant.
blocks.code:
# WRITE - test tenant only. Members of the source group(s) become members of the new dynamic group.
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'Group.ReadWrite.All' -NoWelcome
$source = '<object id of the source group>'
New-MgGroup -DisplayName 'DYN - members of Sales (memberOf test)' -MailNickname 'dyn-memberof-test' `
    -MailEnabled:$false -SecurityEnabled -GroupTypes 'DynamicMembership' `
    -MembershipRule "user.memberof -any (group.objectId -in ['$source'])" `
    -MembershipRuleProcessingState 'On' -WhatIf

blocks.t: Move off it: rebuild the rule with an attribute, or make the group assigned
blocks.warn: Changes membership. Run with -WhatIf first, on one group, and compare the members with the CSV of the previous block.
blocks.code:
# WRITE. Option A - the source group's members share an attribute: replace the rule (here: department).
Update-MgGroup -GroupId '<group id>' -MembershipRule '(user.department -eq "Sales")' -MembershipRuleProcessingState 'On' -WhatIf

# Option B - no attribute fits: make the group assigned (Microsoft's way on Learn: drop only 'DynamicMembership', keep 'Unified').
# Its current members stay; from now on you add and remove them yourself.
$groupId = '<group id>'
$types = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]@((Get-MgGroup -GroupId $groupId -Property GroupTypes).GroupTypes)
[void]$types.Remove('DynamicMembership')
Update-MgGroup -GroupId $groupId -GroupTypes $types.ToArray() -MembershipRuleProcessingState 'Paused' -WhatIf

sources.t: Microsoft Learn: memberOf operator (preview) - migrate before the preview ends
sources.says: After 3 November 2026 dynamic groups, dynamic administrative units and auto-assignment policies that use memberOf stop updating and keep their last state; lists the preview limits (500 groups, 50 source groups, no other conditions).

sources.t: Microsoft Learn: auto-assignment policies - find policies that use memberOf
sources.says: Policies that use memberOf are quarantined from 3 November 2026; Microsoft's read-only script exports them to CSV.
Existing configurations of tenants with Entra ID Governance or higher are supported until 31 March 2027; a replacement is planned for late 2026; automatic migration by the deadline.
